P11.rationale: The page displays concrete before/after data points (24 Std. → Minuten, >200.000€, 4 automated processes) as large typographic callouts and icon-anchored stats, but lacks actual chart frames or visual data plots — the numbers are real and bound to outcomes, though presented as typographic display rather than true data visualisations.

P13.rationale: The right-hand sidebar uses a dark teal/slate panel as a deliberate atmospheric contrast zone against the white left column, creating a two-tone background structure with intentional tonal depth, though there is no texture or gradient atmosphere beyond the flat colour split.
